title: Brainrot Fusion

selected_categories.reasoning: The central mechanic is combining two identical tiers into a higher tier, which is the defining interaction of the game.
The dropped objects use gravity, bounce, friction, wall collision, and stack behavior, so physical positioning directly shapes success and failure.
Much of the appeal comes from glossy object motion, chain merges, audiovisual feedback, and the pleasure of building cleaner stacks.
The player repeatedly performs simple tap/click releases, but outcomes depend on aim and physics rather than idle accumulation or rapid clicking loops.
The game has some soothing visual/audio feedback and repetitive stack-building rhythm, though its failure pressure and chaotic meme tone make relaxation secondary.
